purpose: Books pulled read-only from the live knowledge library for the qwen3.7 comparison. Only chunks eligible for plain production library search are used (searchable, current version, verified excerpt tag at confidence >= 0.8, not non_teaching).
chosen_on: 2026-09-25, from per-book language and script counts of the live library before any retrieval run

multilingual.why: Every book whose eligible chunks carry non-English prose or non-Latin script: vernacular examples with IPA (seven grammars), writing systems (Unicode cookbook), Chinese legal terms, genuine Spanish passages (business ethics, business-government-society, duplicated between them), a Japanese term (operations management), Arabic script (Middle East), sung German/Latin texts (music history). The live library holds no Chinese, Japanese or Korean prose; 'es'/'fr'/'de' detections elsewhere are code, formulas and glossed tables.

statistics.why: All seven statistics books, the subject of the frozen 24 pilot questions; includes the near-duplicate pair os4/ahss4 as production does.

english_spread.why: One book per further subject across sciences, business, law, humanities, computing and health, avoiding near-duplicate pairs (core-concepts-of-marketing but not introducing-marketing).
